record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, soften item embedding normalization from e/||e|| to e/max(||e||,1e-12)^0.9 for both history and candidate lookups, keeping padding exactly zero. This permits modest learned norm variation while retaining most directional normalization, potentially recovering item-specific confidence. Keep dimensions, GRU topology, features, readout, scoring formula, loss and optimizer fixed. Synchronize the predictor writer and checkpoint metadata; retain one model per category.

     def forward(self, indices: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         embeddings = super().forward(indices)
-        embeddings = torch.nn.functional.normalize(embeddings, p=2, dim=-1, eps=1e-12)
+        norms = torch.linalg.vector_norm(embeddings, ord=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        embeddings = embeddings / norms.clamp(min=1e-12).pow(0.9)
         return embeddings.masked_fill(indices.eq(0).unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)

category_rationales.rationale: Soften tied item embedding normalization to e/max(||e||,1e-12)^0.9 for history and candidates across all four datasets. This permits modest learned norm variation while preserving zero padding, dimensions, GRU topology, scoring, loss, optimizer, and one checkpoint per category.
